repos_data.description: Hierarchical Temporal Memory implementation in Java - an official Community-Driven Java port of the Numenta Platform for Intelligent Computing (NuPIC).
(pre-alpha) Implementation of Jeff Hawkins' Hierarchical Temporal Memory & Cortical Learning Algorithm
NuPIC Studio is a powerful all­-in-­one tool that allows users create a HTM neural network from scratch, train it, collect statistics, and share it among the members of the community.
Enterprise Hebbian neural graph for AI memory - CIPS LLC

repo_meta_data.description: Numenta Platform for Intelligent Computing is an implementation of Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM), a theory of intelligence based strictly on the neuroscience of the neocortex.
